steps.instruction: Ask what day and time of day suits the customer best for a call from an advisor.
Summarize in one sentence why an advisor should call, and send the time the customer preferred.

fallback.message: En este momento tenemos una falla técnica y no pude agendar la llamada. Por favor vuelve a llamarnos más tarde. Disculpa las molestias.

en.value: We're having a technical problem right now and I couldn't schedule the call. Please call us again later. Sorry for the inconvenience.

steps.message: Listo. Dejé registrada tu solicitud y un asesor de ${tenant_name} te va a llamar en el horario que me indicaste, dentro del horario legal de cobranza. Gracias por tu tiempo.

en.value: Done. I registered your request and a ${tenant_name} advisor will call you at the time you chose, within legal collection hours. Thank you for your time.
